name: Send Them to Hell
short: Demons want Earth. Bad idea. Smash them back to Hell in a chaotic pixel-meets-3D roguelike of absurd, game-breaking builds. With heroes like a holy Knight, a Corn-Launching Robot, or a Wizard Girlie and her ferocious cat. Play solo or 4-player online co-op. Commence the slaughter. Send Them To Hell.
min_req: Minimum:     OS:  Windows 10 64-bit    Processor:  Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD FX-6300    Memory:  4096 MB RAM    Graphics:  GeForce GTX 460 / Radeon HD 5770 / Intel HD 4000 (OpenGL 3.3)    Network:  Broadband Internet connection    Storage:  2048 MB available space    Sound Card:  Any Windows-compatible audio device    Additional Notes:  Requires an OpenGL 3.3 capable GPU. Java runtime is bundled. Internet connection required for online co-op only.
